title: Tracking Outcomes in Pain Patients Using Fitness Devices
brief_summary: The investigators are assessing the validity of fitness devices as surrogate measures of chronic pain survey outcomes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Back pain which may benefit from epidural injection
* Assenting to epidural injection for back pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to wear fitness tracking device
study_population: Adult patients with chronic back pain
